# TravelNepal
> Intelligent Multi-Agent Tourism, Verified Stays & Digital Transit Ecosystem in Nepal

## Overview
TravelNepal is Nepal's premier digital tourism platform connecting travelers with verified accommodations, authentic dining, licensed Himalayan trekking guides, and intercity transit routing with government-approved student discounts.

## Core Features
- **AI Travel Specialist**: Multi-agent trip planning for all destinations in Nepal (Pokhara, Kathmandu, Chitwan, Mustang, Lumbini, Ilam, Dharan, Rara).
- **Verified Hotels & Stays**: Direct room reservations with instant Khalti digital wallet payment integration.
- **Intercity Transit & Student Discounts**: Accurate highway route calculations with 45% student bus fare concessions.
- **Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) Workspaces**: Partner dashboards for hotel owners, restaurant managers, and tour guides.
- **Context-Aware Speech Correction**: Sanitizes phonetic speech-to-text transcription errors in English, Nepali, and Romanized Nepali.
